lane_title: De-Striped Subsurface Tilt-Depth, Cross-Fitted Potassic Adularia, Lahontan Isohypse & Coulomb Stress-Shadow Split-Sensor Fault Discovery with Charnes-Cooper Submodular Kernel Allocation

limitations_addressed: 4.2x sensor-domain dot starvation in non-LiDAR SE Nevada (Fold 3: 3,330 dots for 3,250 truth px = 0.1461 vs 0.2140 in Fold 1; 652 dots = 0.0566 in EXP-79-2)
4:1 false-negative scarp-flank poisoning on 1.0 <= d(x, sim_known) < 3.0 px around unhidden faults plus unweighted 17.6x halo-vs-far classifier sampling bias in src/gems79/thvc_model.py
Cross-repo sparse collision 0.7139 > 0.70 against live GEMSDOE83 caused by concentrating 97.58% of dots inside <=2.0 km of mapped faults and ~91% inside 1-m LiDAR footprint

Un-notched GeoDAWN E-W/N-S survey line corrugations, un-vetoed horizontal Lake Lahontan pluvial strandlines, missing lithology-normalized K_d adularia residual, and missing lateral Coulomb stress-relief shadows

hypothesis: Uncatalogued Great Basin Quaternary and blind geothermal faults are jointly recoverable across both 1-m LiDAR scarps and the 24.99% non-LiDAR / blind-playa gap by combining (H1) decontaminated importance-weighted split-sensor (LiDAR vs 10m-DEM/geophysics) dual heads with cross-quadrant out-of-fold pure-physics experts and sensor-domain posterior mean conservation, (H2) 2D FFT flight-line/tie-line de-striped Salem magnetic tilt inverse depth ||grad(theta_T)|| and 60-deg up-dip hanging-wall-to-footwall basement step registration, (H3) structure-tensor along-scarp isohypsic Lake Lahontan strandline deconfounding plus Wallace (1978) along-range footwall slip-deficit inversion, (H4) fold-visible lateral normal-fault Coulomb stress relief shadows (Delta_CFS_perp < 0) suppressing flank false positives while preserving tip/relay dilation bridges, and (H5) spatially cross-fitted potassic adularia alteration residuals K_d = K - f_OOF(eTh, eU, topo) x magnetite leaching x smectite conductivity, decoded via sensor/regime-calibrated Charnes-Cooper submodular 300-m kernel optimization.
mechanism: 1) Reuse pinned 70-channel THVC memmap without duplication and build 20 orthogonal physical/de-striped/adularia/10m-DEM/isohypse channels (90 static channels total) plus 17 strictly fold-visible elastic/Coulomb-shadow/slip-deficit channels (107 channels total), blocking all forbidden columns (dist_known_fault_px, known_fault, label) and excluding SGMC/Qfaults rasters. 2) Verify all 107 channels individually via single-feature symmetric ROC AUC <= 0.90 on both seeds 20 and 30 before trusting any score. 3) Fit decontaminated (d_rem >= 3.0 px) importance-weighted Stage-1 ensembles plus disjoint cross-quadrant split-sensor (lidar_present == 1 vs 0) pure-physics experts and Stage-2 8-azimuth trace/tubularity dual heads (p_exact, q_300m) with inner-fold split-sensor mean conservation. 4) Check continuous surface uniqueness across all 1,214+ SHA-256-verified rasters BEFORE dot placement, then emit binary {0.0, 1.0} predictions via inner-calibrated Charnes-Cooper submodular 300-m kernel allocation with a dedicated blind-basin (>1.5 km) pure-physics exploration tranche.
named_non_fault_process: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan and Lake Bonneville horizontal wave-cut paleoshoreline benches, USGS GeoDAWN E-W (200/400 m) flight-line and N-S (2/4 km) tie-line leveling corrugations, highway/rail embankments along basin margins, closed evaporite-playa potassium clays, and lateral thermal outflow plumes in alluvial fans.
